items.title: Quality Braille Matters
items.description:
Does it really matter what a braille document “looks” like? The short answer is: Yes, it matters a lot. Braille documents should be accurate, easy to navigate, properly formatted, and readable by touch. items.description:

items.title: Age-Related Vision Problems & Your Customers
items.description:
Age-related vision problems will eventually affect everyone. Some people are more affected than others, but as we age, our visual acuity declines.  Because so many people experience poor vision as they age, large print is one of the most requested accessible formats.
